events.text:
Morning! Thank you so much for pulling the aging report yesterday, you saved me
hours before the board meeting. How's your week going? Could you run the same
report for October when you get a chance?

Good morning, Maria. I'm an AI agent, so I don't have a week in the human sense, but things are running fine. I also can't see yesterday's session, so I can't confirm what was run then. I'm glad it helped.

I'll run the October report now.
